paragraphs: 🎓 19-year-old full-stack developer from Tunisia with 3 years of freelance/client experience. 💻 I craft beautiful, secure, and scalable applications with modern technologies. From web and mobile to desktop, I turn complex problems into elegant solutions.

My Journey: I began my coding journey with Python and web development fundamentals, and I've since progressed through JavaScript, React, and modern full-stack development with Next.js, React Native, and serverless architectures. I build production web apps end-to-end — frontend, backend, and deployment — and I'm currently expanding into Rust (Actix Web / Axum) to work on performance-critical backend services. What drives me is creating secure, scalable applications that solve real problems. Lately that also means building my own tooling: nour-code, a local AI coding agent that runs Qwen3 8B…
📌 Check my pinned repos below for what I actually build — that's a better signal than any project count.
features: VexOS Desktop is a live Linux desktop built from Debian trixie for web and software development. Boot one ISO in VirtualBox and you get XFCE, Firefox ESR, Python 3, Node.js with npm, Rust with cargo, gcc, git, and VexOS…
Built from source: the image is made with live-build, and every package list is a plain text file in the repo.
Clean by design: the live session runs in RAM, so a reboot restores the system to its starting state.
Ready to code: the compilers, runtimes, and the IDE are already set up when it boots.
